experiment: AVX-512 shared coefficients across eight independent segments

environment.note: Shared host frequencies and other tenants were not controlled; all native benchmarks and builds in this task were serialized.

provenance.note: The candidate header comment was updated after compilation; no declarations or C expressions changed. Fast_dft.c is exactly the measured compiled source.
provenance.source_tree_reference: Native source hashes identify the measured versions independently of commit author metadata and publishing commit hashes.

configuration.ordering: Per length/repetition randomized variant order using Python Random(4489)
configuration.timer: Native c_segments_s; coefficient copies/preparation excluded; full native wall also retained

whole_api_configuration.warmup: One complete requested call per library and worker count, followed by fresh preparation on every ordinary call
whole_api_configuration.excluded: Imports, data creation, comparison, hashes and JSON writes
whole_api_configuration.segment_start_rule: start=0.0; istart=floor(start+0.5); start+=shift using repeated double addition

prototype_api_notes: Three calls per configuration, including the noisy W8 samples, are all retained. The pure batch8/batch8all prototypes replaced four-way batching instead of retaining four-way remainders. Initial profiled calls accidentally retained only API metadata; their whole-call times remain below, and the subsequent separate pair contains complete frequency profiles.
candidate_pairing: Eight pairs, baseline/candidate for even pairs and candidate/baseline for odd pairs. Every comparison passed float32 PSD byte equality.

baseline.note: Per-worker elapsed times overlap and must not be summed as wall clock.

import ctypes as ct
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DEST = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = (ROOT / 'lpsd_fast/_native/fast_dft.c').read_text()
FLAGS = ['-O3', '-std=c11', '-fno-fast-math', '-ffp-contract=off', '-fPIC', '-march=native', '-fopenmp-simd', '-shared']

def batched(text, count, threshold):
    if count == 4:
        return text.replace('segLen >= 2048 && navg - ii >= 4', f'segLen >= {threshold} && navg - ii >= 4')
    begin = text.index('static LPSD_ALWAYS_INLINE void dot_psd_four_anchored_simd')
    end = text.index('static LPSD_ALWAYS_INLINE void dot_csd_anchored_simd', begin)
    code = f'static LPSD_ALWAYS_INLINE void dot_psd_four_anchored_simd(' + ', '.join(f'const double *x{b}' for b in range(count))
    code += ', const double *qr, const double *qi, long int length, double *rr, double *ri) {\n'
    code += '\n'.join(f'const double a{b} = x{b}[0]; double r{b}=0., i{b}=0.;' for b in range(count))
    code += '\n#pragma omp simd reduction(+:' + ','.join(f'r{b},i{b}' for b in range(count)) + ')\n'
    code += 'for(long int j=0; j<length; ++j) {const double real=qr[j], imag=qi[j];\n'
    code += '\n'.join(f'const double v{b}=x{b}[j]-a{b}; r{b}+=real*v{b}; i{b}+=imag*v{b};' for b in range(count))
    code += '}\n' + '\n'.join(f'rr[{b}]=r{b}; ri[{b}]=i{b};' for b in range(count)) + '}\n\n'
    text = text[:begin]+code+text[end:]
    begin = text.index('if (batched && mode >= 2 && !csd')
    end = text.index('        const long int istart', text.index('            continue;', begin))
    old = text[begin:end]
    new = old.replace('segLen >= 2048',f'segLen >= {threshold}').replace('navg - ii >= 4',f'navg - ii >= {count}').replace('[4]',f'[{count}]').replace('b < 4',f'b < {count}').replace('ii += 3', f'ii += {count-1}')
    new = new.replace('segments[0], segments[1],\n                                       segments[2], segments[3],', ', '.join(f'segments[{b}]' for b in range(count)) + ',')
    return text[:begin]+new+text[end:]

def stats(text):
    # Avoid the imaginary division when its exact numerator and previous mean
    # are both zero. Preserve the real operation order and exceptional path.
    return text.replace('*Mr_i += Qr_i / ii;', 'if (Qr_i != 0.0 || *Mr_i != 0.0) { *Mr_i += Qr_i / ii; }')

def splitdot(text, count):
    begin=text.index('    const double anchor = x[0];',text.index('static LPSD_ALWAYS_INLINE void dot_psd_anchored_simd'))
    end=text.index('\n}\n',begin)
    code = f'    const double anchor = x[0]; const long int chunk = length / {count};\n'
    code += '\n'.join(f'    double r{b}=0., i{b}=0.;' for b in range(count))
    code += '\n    #pragma omp simd reduction(+:' + ','.join(f'r{b},i{b}' for b in range(count)) + ')\n'
    code += '    for(long int j=0; j<chunk; ++j) {\n'
    code += '\n'.join(f'      const long int p{b}=j+{b}*chunk; const double v{b}=x[p{b}]-anchor; r{b}+=qr[p{b}]*v{b}; i{b}+=qi[p{b}]*v{b};' for b in range(count))
    code += '}\n    double r=' + '+'.join(f'r{b}' for b in range(count)) + ', im=' + '+'.join(f'i{b}' for b in range(count)) + ';\n'
    code += f'    for(long int j={count}*chunk; j<length; ++j) {{const double v=x[j]-anchor; r+=qr[j]*v; im+=qi[j]*v;}}\n'
    code += '    *rr=r; *ri=im;'
    return text[:begin]+code+text[end:]

def compile_variant(name, text):
    snapshot=DEST/name
    snapshot.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for relative in ('lpsd_fast/_native','lpsd/c_sources'):
        (snapshot/relative).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        for source in (ROOT/relative).glob('*'):
            if source.suffix in ('.h','.c'):
                shutil.copy2(source,snapshot/relative/source.name)
    source=snapshot/'lpsd_fast/_native/fast_dft.c'
    source.write_text(text)
    binary=DEST/(name+'.so')
    subprocess.run(['cc',*FLAGS,str(source),'-o',str(binary),'-lm'],check=True)
    return binary

def load(path):
    lib=ct.CDLL(str(path))
    fn=lib.fast_dft_selected_profile
    dp=ct.POINTER(ct.c_double)
    fn.argtypes=[dp,dp,dp,dp,ct.POINTER(ct.c_long),dp,dp,ct.c_long,ct.c_long,dp,dp,ct.c_double,ct.c_int,ct.c_bool,ct.c_int,ct.c_bool,ct.c_bool,dp,dp]
    fn.restype=ct.c_int
    return lib,fn

def main():
    cases={'baseline':None,'stats':stats(BASE),'batch8':batched(BASE,8,2048),'batch4all':batched(BASE,4,1),'batch8all':batched(BASE,8,1),'batch4_256':batched(BASE,4,256),'batch8stats':stats(batched(BASE,8,2048)),'split2':splitdot(BASE,2),'split4':splitdot(BASE,4)}
    for name,text in cases.items():
        if text is not None: compile_variant(name,text)
    libraries={name:load(DEST/(name+'.so')) for name in cases}
    data=np.random.default_rng(20261008).normal(size=10_000_000)
    dp=ct.POINTER(ct.c_double)
    output=[ct.c_double() for _ in range(6)]
    navg=ct.c_long()
    rng=random.Random(4489)
    results=[]
    for length in (128,192,256,512,1024,2047,2048,4096,16384,65536,262144,1048576):
        j=np.arange(length)
        window=np.kaiser(length+1,23.7)[:-1]
        cr=np.ascontiguousarray(window*np.cos(2*np.pi*13.712*j/length))
        ci=np.ascontiguousarray(window*np.sin(2*np.pi*13.712*j/length))
        variants=[]
        for rep in range(6):
            names=list(cases)
            rng.shuffle(names)
            for name in names:
                a,b=cr.copy(),ci.copy()
                t=time.perf_counter()
                status=libraries[name][1](*[ct.byref(v) for v in output[:4]],ct.byref(navg),data.ctypes.data_as(dp),None,len(data),length,a.ctypes.data_as(dp),b.ctypes.data_as(dp),75.,0,False,2,False,True,ct.byref(output[4]),ct.byref(output[5]))
                wall=time.perf_counter()-t
                assert status==0
                variants.append({'name':name,'rep':rep,'wall_s':wall,'segments_s':output[5].value,'preparation_s':output[4].value,'real':output[0].value,'imag':output[1].value,'segments':navg.value})
        med={name:float(np.median([v['segments_s'] for v in variants if v['name']==name and v['rep']>0])) for name in cases}
        ratios={name:round(med['baseline']/value,3) for name,value in med.items()}
        print(length,ratios,flush=True)
        results.append({'length':length,'medians':med,'samples':variants})
        (DEST/'micro.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__': main()

import ctypes as ct
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lpsd_fast import api, lpsd

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
api._native()
declarations=api._LIB
libraries={}
for name in ('baseline','batch8','batch8all'):
    lib=ct.CDLL(str(HERE/(name+'.so')))
    for symbol, declaration in list(vars(declarations).items()):
        if isinstance(declaration,ct._CFuncPtr):
            fn=getattr(lib,symbol)
            fn.argtypes,fn.restype=declaration.argtypes,declaration.restype
    libraries[name]=lib
data=pd.Series(np.random.default_rng(20261008).normal(size=10_000_000),copy=False)
results=[]
reference=None
for workers in (1,8):
    kwargs=dict(sample_rate=1.,n_frequencies=1000,n_averages=100,kernel='fast',outputs='psd',workers=workers,max_working_mb=4096)
    for name,lib in libraries.items():
        api._LIB=lib
        lpsd(data,**kwargs)
    for rep in range(3):
        names=list(libraries)
        random.Random(2118+rep).shuffle(names)
        for name in names:
            api._LIB=libraries[name]
            t=time.perf_counter()
            output=lpsd(data,**kwargs)
            elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t
            if name=='baseline': reference=output
            error=None if reference is None else float(np.max(np.abs(output.psd.to_numpy()/reference.psd.to_numpy()-1)))
            item=dict(workers=workers,rep=rep,name=name,wall_s=elapsed,max_relative_error=error)
            results.append(item)
            print(item,flush=True)
            (HERE/'api.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
    for name in ('baseline','batch8all'):
        api._LIB=libraries[name]
        t=time.perf_counter()
        output=lpsd(data,profile=True,**kwargs)
        item=dict(workers=workers,name=name,profile_wall_s=time.perf_counter()-t,profile=output.attrs['lpsd_fast'])
        (HERE/f'profile-{workers}-{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps(item,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Completed',flush=True)

import ctypes as ct
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lpsd_fast import api,lpsd

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
api._native()
decl=api._LIB
libs={}
for name in ('baseline','candidate'):
    lib=ct.CDLL(str(HERE/(name+'.so')))
    for symbol,d in list(vars(decl).items()):
        if isinstance(d,ct._CFuncPtr):
            fn=getattr(lib,symbol)
            fn.argtypes,fn.restype=d.argtypes,d.restype
    libs[name]=lib
data=pd.Series(np.random.default_rng(20261008).normal(size=10_000_000),copy=False)
kwargs=dict(sample_rate=1.,n_frequencies=1000,n_averages=100,kernel='fast',outputs='psd',max_working_mb=4096)
samples=[]
for name,lib in libs.items():
    api._LIB=lib
    lpsd(data,workers=8,**kwargs)
reference=None
for rep in range(8):
    names=('baseline','candidate') if rep%2==0 else ('candidate','baseline')
    for name in names:
        api._LIB=libs[name]
        start=time.perf_counter()
        output=lpsd(data,workers=8,**kwargs)
        elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
        if reference is None:reference=output
        item=dict(name=name,rep=rep,workers=8,wall_s=elapsed,equal=output.psd.to_numpy().tobytes()==reference.psd.to_numpy().tobytes())
        samples.append(item)
        print(item,flush=True)
        (HERE/'verify.json').write_text(json.dumps(samples,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,lib in libs.items():
    api._LIB=lib
    output=lpsd(data,workers=1,profile=True,**kwargs)
    profile=output.attrs['lpsd_profile']
    (HERE/f'final-profile-{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps(profile,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('profile',name,profile['channel_wall_s'],sum(r['c_segments_s'] for r in profile['frequencies']),flush=True)

validation.note: Native batch validation spans boundaries/remainders, fractional starts, order 0/1, compensated mode 3, white/DC/tone/constant inputs and nonfinite/overflow behavior; the public API itself rejects nonfinite input.

limitations: One x86-64 AVX-512 host; no AArch64 or GPU speed claim.
Whole API references are identical estimators with unchanged Python wrapper; no FFT replacement or subsampling.
A single serial profile is diagnostic; timings from overlapping workers must not be interpreted as wall percentages.
The 256<=L<2048 diagnostic bucket regressed in the serial profile; changing thresholds requires new paired length evidence.
